Agent Name: Assistant  
Step Number: 31  
Reason for Mistake: The final calculation is wrong because it assumes only the 5-year-old pays admission and incorrectly excludes the 2-year-old from daily ticket costs, even though the search result said children ages 1–12 are charged admission and only infants under 12 months are free. It also compares a 4-visit daily total of $99 against a $300 annual membership, concluding “-201” rather than identifying the correct savings/loss.
